name: Can I repair minor ceiling water damage myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair minor ceiling water damage myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you might be able to handle very minor cosmetic ceiling water damage, such as a small stain from a past, resolved leak, it's generally advisable to consult professionals. Even small visible damage can indicate larger hidden issues like saturated insulation or mold growth. Without proper assessment and drying equipment, you risk missing underlying problems that could lead to recurring damage or health hazards. Professionals ensure proper drying and complete remediation.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can attempt minor cosmetic repairs, but professionals are recommended for proper assessment and to prevent hidden issues like mold or structural damage.
